subject: EGM P2 review after shell syntax validation
body: Validate pinned review runner via bash -n, then perform real installed EGM independent Goldfish review with companion source provenance; no P2 art changes, no merge.

argv:
set -euo pipefail
SHA="41088c777428f532c0dd154e710a2f89654be3f9"
REPO="${DORE_REPO_ROOT:-$HOME/westsidewatch.github.io}"
if [[ ! -d "$REPO/.git" && ! -f "$REPO/.git" ]]; then REPO="$HOME/.dore/control-checkout"; fi
if [[ ! -d "$REPO/.git" && ! -f "$REPO/.git" ]]; then echo "A2A DISPATCH ERROR: no known resident checkout" >&2; exit 2; fi
git -C "$REPO" fetch --no-tags origin "+refs/heads/p2-latest-magazine-motion-preview-20261023:refs/remotes/origin/p2-latest-magazine-motion-preview-20261023"
if [[ "$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/p2-latest-magazine-motion-preview-20261023)" != "$SHA" ]]; then echo "A2A DISPATCH ERROR: source lease changed" >&2; exit 3; fi
mkdir -p "$HOME/.dore/egm-dispatch"
SCRIPT="$HOME/.dore/egm-dispatch/chatgpt-egm-p2-native-goldfish-20261027-0640-pin-syntax.sh"
git -C "$REPO" show "$SHA:scripts/p2-egm-a2a-review.sh" > "$SCRIPT"
export PATH="$HOME/.codex/plugins/.plugin-appserver/codex-cli/bin:/Applications/ChatGPT.app/Contents/Resources/codex-cli/bin:$PATH"
CLI="$(command -v codex || true)"
if [[ ! -x "$CLI" ]]; then echo "A2A ERROR: verified Codex CLI is not executable" >&2; exit 6; fi
printf 'A2A EGM: using official Codex CLI: %s\n' "$CLI"
bash -n "$SCRIPT"
P2_A2A_SOURCE_SHA="$SHA" DORE_REPO_ROOT="$REPO" bash "$SCRIPT"
